paper.citation: Chakrabortty, A. and Cai, T. (2018). Efficient and adaptive linear regression in semi-supervised settings. The Annals of Statistics 46(4), 1541-1572. DOI: 10.1214/17-AOS1594.
paper.title: Efficient and adaptive linear regression in semi-supervised settings
paper.source_version: Published journal PDF hosted by the University of Pennsylvania, 32 pages; issue August 2018.
paper.source_locator: Section 6.1, model (iii), journal p. 1559 = PDF p. 19; n=500 and N=10000 on journal p. 1558 = PDF p. 18; regression target in Section 2.

mechanism.name: Two-Component Interaction Semi-Supervised Projection Intercept

generation_equations.label: Covariates
generation_equations.expression: Coordinates independent N(0,1) conditional on -5 <= X_j <= 5; implemented by rejection, not clipping. This makes the source restriction explicit.

generation_equations.label: Response
generation_equations.expression: Y = (X^T b)(1 + X^T delta) + epsilon; epsilon ~ N(0,1)

generation_equations.label: Sampling and observed data
generation_equations.expression: Independent units and independent outcome noise. Two iid samples from the same population; fixed group sizes, R indicates observed Y. Export X,R,Y_obs where Y_obs=Y when R=1 and 0 otherwise; n_total=nL+nU.

sampling.dependence: Independent complete-data units; fixed labeled/unlabeled group indicators, not independent Bernoulli indicators. Coordinate dependence is specified in equations.
sampling.n_semantics: n is combined table row count
sampling.predictor_source: No external or oracle predictor supplied. Downstream nuisance regressors must be trained on labeled training folds only; cross-fitting and tuning belong to the later estimator benchmark. No prediction is substituted for Y_obs.

assumptions: Independent individuals; labeled and unlabeled observations have the same covariate law and common complete-data population.
Fixed-size labeling independent of X,Y (two-sample/MCAR design); no MAR selection or distribution shift.
Independent noise as specified; finite second moments; R must mask all uses of Y_obs.

properties.notes: Total input dimension 10; source Section 6.1(iii) NL2C. All ten coordinates enter the index products; polynomial terms are explicit. Fixed p=10 is not called high-dimensional relative to 500 labels.

estimand.name: alpha_projection = E[Y]
estimand.definition: Intercept alpha of argmin_(alpha,beta) E[(Y-alpha-X^T beta)^2]; since E[X]=0 and Cov(X) is positive definite, alpha=E[Y].

parameters.scenario_origin: Source p=10 and coefficient vectors; conditional truncation is an explicit implementation convention, not a verified author-code detail.

truth.expression: Intercept alpha of argmin_(alpha,beta) E[(Y-alpha-X^T beta)^2]; since E[X]=0 and Cov(X) is positive definite, alpha=E[Y].
truth.derivation: Projection intercept equals E[Y] because E[X]=0; truncated Gaussian second moment

parameters.scenario_origin: Source p=10 and coefficient vectors; conditional truncation is an explicit implementation convention, not a verified author-code detail.

truth.expression: Intercept alpha of argmin_(alpha,beta) E[(Y-alpha-X^T beta)^2]; since E[X]=0 and Cov(X) is positive definite, alpha=E[Y].
truth.derivation: Projection intercept equals E[Y] because E[X]=0; truncated Gaussian second moment

adaptations: Map the two-sample SS design to one numeric table. API n is total rows, not the paper labeled n; R=1 for labeled rows; Y_obs=0 for R=0 is a sentinel, never a label. Source reference sample sizes are stored separately.
For arbitrary CPU test n, labeled_count=max(1,min(n-1,floor(n*nL_ref/(nL_ref+nU_ref)))); first labeled_count rows form the independent labeled sample. At n=nL_ref+nU_ref the source counts are exact.
Independent NumPy PCG64 implementation; no author code copied; original estimator tuning, fitted predictions, repeated CI experiments and PFN training are outside this DGP collection.
Fix p=10; retain both source coefficient vectors as scenarios, not separate mechanisms.

The paper states restriction to [-5,5]^p without specifying clipping versus rejection. We explicitly define independent conditional truncated normals via rejection; this is a declared adaptation requiring reviewer confirmation, not exact author-code reproduction.
Select the intercept component of the population least-squares projection with an intercept. Since E[X]=0, this scalar equals E[Y]; the full regression vector is outside the scalar truth interface.
